opening.argument: The video makes a direct recruitment offer, not a neutral discussion of trading. It instructs viewers to “join me for this video to my referral link for MTI” and offers “one direct referral for each one of you,” with a possible increase to two. The arrangement also requires participants to send “your name and your raf link,” after which the speaker says, “i'm going to change my raf link to yours.” These instructions tie participation to referral-link circulation and team-building benefits. The observable solicitation is therefore enrollment in a trading and referral scheme, with consequential recruitment activity rather than mere commentary.
